name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceReadPaperLandingActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects a rewarded reading task. It shows the reading material, counts completed reading, verifies progress, and awards the configured reward.
disableEffect: The rewarded reading campaign will stop, and rewards for completing it will no longer be granted.
